articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT), today announced the pricing of its upsized underwritten public offering (the “Offering”) of $135,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.00% convertible senior notes due 2030 (the “Notes”). The sale of the Notes is expected to close on October 2, 2025, subject to customary closing conditions. The Company also granted the underwriters in the Offering a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional $15,000,000 aggregate principal amount of Notes on the same terms and conditions, solely to cover over-allotments.
articles.title: Bit Digital Announces Pricing of Upsized $135 Million Convertible Notes Offering

articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT), today announced its monthly Ethereum (“ETH”) treasury and staking metrics for the month of August 2025.
articles.title: Bit Digital Inc. Reports Monthly Ethereum Treasury and Staking Metrics for August 2025

articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT), today announced a proposed registered underwritten public offering (the “Offering”) by the Company of $100,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its convertible senior notes due 2030 (the “Notes”), subject to market and other conditions. The Company also intends to grant the underwriters in the Offering a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional $15,000,000 aggregate principal amount of Notes on the same terms and conditions, solely to cover over-allotments.
articles.title: Bit Digital Announces Proposed Offering of $100 Million Convertible Notes
